name: minecraft-mcp
description: Ask about your Minecraft server and let Claude run it: players, worlds, stats, configs, logs, and live events.
long_description: Connects Claude to a Paper server that runs the WorldAPI plugin. Ask who’s online, why the server lags, who played the most this week, or have it set the time, give items, read the logs, and kick a griefer. Needs WorldAPI 3.0.0 or newer. The permissions of the WorldAPI token you enter decide what Claude may do: a viewer token only looks.

worldapi_url.title: WorldAPI URL
worldapi_url.description: Your server’s WorldAPI address including /api/v1, such as http://localhost:8110/api/v1. Leave it empty for the singleplayer world you play with the WorldAPI mod.

worldapi_token.title: WorldAPI token
worldapi_token.description: A token from WorldAPI’s in-game menu or config.yml. Empty gives what anonymous visitors may read.

player.title: Your player name
player.description: Optional: who “I” and “me” mean when you ask about yourself

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that changes the server
